diagnosis.text: DIAGNOSIS: The `login_popup_confirm` step is still enabled despite the one-time popup being gone, burning 240 total seconds per cycle (120s × 2 passes) waiting for a template that never appears — this caused `dmz_lobby_check` to time out on the first pass and forced recovery; the dashboard then misread the successful run's `reason: null` field as an unknown failure instead of checking `ok: true` first.
